name: Enthalpy v0.4.12
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.12

## Fixed

- Windows: Open from Sync on the application start screen — one successful
  account sign-in now continues to vault select (remote workspace, passphrase,
  folder, Open workspace). Version 0.4.11 showed the form but ignored a correct
  submit and asked again.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
